api_host.description: Host of the Helpdesk Power Suite API (no https://). Keep the default unless you self-host the gateway.

freshworks_domain.description: Your Freshdesk or Freshservice domain, e.g. acme.freshdesk.com

freshworks_api_key.description: API key of an admin (Profile settings → View API key). Used server-side only to read tickets, contacts, companies and field definitions for exports.
